key_insight: Simulations suggest parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) can approximate the Boltzmann sampling needed for restricted Boltzmann machine training on tractable instances.
engineering_relevance: QAOA-assisted sampling could support quantum-enhanced generative-model training, but practical benefits over classical sampling remain unproven.
method: Simulate PAQ-QAOA circuits with Qiskit Aer.
Analyze sampled distributions through inverse effective temperature κ.
Evaluate Boltzmann sampling for tractable RBM problem sizes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical evidence from Qiskit Aer simulations supporting approximate RBM Boltzmann sampling for the tractable instances considered.
watch_item: Hardware performance, scaling, and circuit-depth requirements for larger problems remain open questions.
paper_title: $κ$-Parametrized Boltzmann Distribution Sampling on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
